newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY LEAGUE-MANLY CLAIM TOP SPOT FOR ARL PLAY-OFFS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE-MANLY CLAIM TOP SPOT FOR ARL PLAY-OFFS.

text.p: Four tries from discarded
international wing John Hopoate helped Manly to claim first
place in the Australian Rugby League (ARL) standings as they
completed their regular season matches with a resounding 48-10
defeat of lowly South Sydney on Sunday.
Manly, coached by Australia boss Bob Fulton, lived up to
their early season status as favourites by running in nine tries
in all to end their campaign two points clear of fast-finishing
Brisbane who secured second place with a 38-6 defeat of Auckland
on Friday.
North Sydney beat Gold Coast 38-8 on Sunday for third place
while Sydney City managed to reverse a recent slump in form to
beat Sydney Tigers 24-10 and grab fourth place.
Cronulla secured fifth place with a 22-0 defeat of Newcastle
on Saturday, with Canberra sixth after trouncing South
Queensland 36-10 on Sunday.
On Friday, St George eased past Western Reds 22-16 for
seventh while Western Suburbs claimed eighth place by beating
Illawarra 12-8.
The top eight sides in the standings now go through to the
ARL's complicated system of play-offs which begin next week. The
top four have two chances of reaching the final while the bottom
four play sudden-death matches.
Manly now play Sydney City next Sunday while Brisbane take
on North Sydney on Saturday.
In the elimination finals, Cronulla play Western Suburbs on
Friday and St George meet Canberra on Saturday.
The winners of those matches go on to play the defeated
teams from the play-offs among the top four sides.
